description: Angular component template for configuring argument mappings in a rule node within the Thingsboard UI, including drag-and-drop, form controls, and dynamic argument handling.

methods.name: onDrop
methods.description: Handles the drop event for drag-and-drop argument reordering.

methods.name: removeArgument
methods.description: Removes an argument at the specified index.

methods.name: addArgument
methods.description: Adds a new argument to the arguments list.
